name: fusebase-apps
description: Create FuseBase apps by asking your agent. Installs and authenticates the fusebase CLI when it is first needed.

interface.longDescription: Ask your agent for an app and it creates one on FuseBase. The plugin carries two skills: one that creates a product with the fusebase CLI and hands off to the generated project, and one that installs, updates and authenticates the CLI the first time it is needed.
defaultPrompt: Build me an expense tracker on FuseBase
Create a new FuseBase app for onboarding requests
